title: Liverpool v Real Madrid · shot hits the arm

ai.explanation: Attacker A strikes a shot toward goal, and defender B slides inside his own penalty area with his arm extended away from his body. The ball hits the defender's arm, which has made his body unnaturally bigger, creating a handball offence. Because this offence took place inside the defender's own penalty area, a penalty kick is awarded. No disciplinary card is issued because the handball was non-deliberate and a penalty kick restores the attacking opportunity.
gray_areas: Whether the defender's arm position was a natural result of his body movement while sliding to block the shot.

title: England v Mexico · slide on the touchline

ai.explanation: Player A launched a sliding tackle with a straight leg and studs exposed, connecting directly with Player B's shin. Even though Player A touched the ball first, taking the ball does not permit a tackle that endangers the safety of an opponent. Making contact high on the leg with exposed studs endangers player safety and constitutes serious foul play. Play restarts with a direct free kick for the green team outside the penalty area, and Player A is sent off with a red card.

adjustments: -0.25: red card depends on studs showing, read from the video alone

gray_areas: Because the speed and force of the challenge were recorded as medium and the defender touched the ball first, some referees might judge that the contact lacked sufficient force for a red card and instead sanction it as a reckless tackle with a yellow card.
This red card depends on studs showing, read from the video alone. If that reading is wrong, the card would probably be lower.

title: Youth league · trip near the box

ai.explanation: Dark Blue Defender lunges in from behind and to the side with an extended leg, missing the ball and tripping White 13 as he dribbles through midfield. Because physical contact is made during a mistimed sliding tackle, the referee awards a direct free kick to the white team outside the penalty area. The tackle is made with medium force without clear evidence of endangering the opponent's safety, classifying it as a careless foul. Consequently, no disciplinary card is required for this challenge.

title: Anderlecht v Oostende · trip in the box

ai.explanation: Defender B lunges across attacker A inside the penalty area, missing the ball completely and tripping the attacker's foot. Because defender B made a mistimed slide while trying to reach the ball with medium force, the action is evaluated as a careless tackle rather than a reckless foul. A direct free kick offence committed inside the defender's own penalty area results in a penalty kick for the attacking team. No disciplinary card is issued because the foul was careless and occurred during a genuine attempt to play the ball.
gray_areas: Uncertainty regarding studs showing could raise the foul to reckless if studs made severe contact, though video compression makes exact boot detail difficult to verify.
The presence of defender C tracking nearby determines whether this was stopping a promising attack or denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity.
